decisions.why: Access 2, Access AMH, Access C Peptide are Beckman Coulter Access-family immunoassay analysers - lab analyser equipment.
Coulter Act 5Diff AL and Cellavision are haematology analysers/morphology systems - lab analyser equipment.
Bruker Maldi Biotyper System is a microbial identification mass-spec analyser - lab analyser equipment.
AU480/AU5800/AU680 are Beckman Coulter clinical chemistry analysers - lab analyser equipment.
Aution Eleven/Max and DxU 1800/1800C are urinalysis analysers - lab analyser equipment.
DxOne Command Central, Insights, Inventory Manager and Workflow Manager are laboratory departmental software/informatics products.
Automate 2500, DxA 5000 and Power Express are laboratory sample-processing automation systems - lab equipment.
Statspin Cytofuge/Express series are clinical laboratory centrifuges - lab equipment.
PK7300/PK7400 are Beckman Coulter automated immunohematology/blood-bank analysers - lab equipment.
DxC 500i Clinical Analyzer is a lab analyser - lab analyser equipment.
Immage 800 is a protein chemistry (nephelometric) analyser - lab analyser equipment.
